brief_summary: Hero art for the Trends pillar piece on the Hall Effect/Rapid Trigger tracker score climbing to its ceiling across seven weekly points then posting its first ever down tick on the eighth. A coral sparkline over a faint warm-grey keyboard side-profile ground silhouette, a dashed ceiling reference at the score-100 line, a dashed drop bracket flagging the magnitude of the final dip, a haloed focal dot at the terminal point, and the family's warm-bronze theme dot in the upper-right margin.
source: plan/bearings.md section Article hero art, colorful keyboard SVGs (locked 2026-05-09), trends piece maps to sparkline silhouette; cf. apps/web/public/hero-art/hall-effect-rapid-trigger-plateau.svg for the prior entry in this tracker's sparkline sequence
template: directive: simple line drawing + single splash of color illustrative of subject; trends piece -> sparkline silhouette, optionally paired with a secondary keyboard motif per brief
subject: An eight-point sparkline (tracker weeks ending in 2026-W44) tracing scores 98, 97, 98, 98, 99, 100, 100, 95: a minor early wobble, a climb into a two-week ceiling plateau at 100, then a sharp final-point drop to 95, the category's first down tick in eight tracked weeks. A coral wash sits under the plateau region as the visual memory of the climb; a dashed ceiling line marks the score-100 line the category had just pinned; a dashed vertical bracket from the ceiling down to the final point flags the magnitude of the drop; the terminal point is enlarged with a halo ring. A low-opacity warm-grey keyboard side-profile silhouette (case body with a typing-angle tilt and a row of keycap deck gaps) sits beneath the chart as a quiet grounding motif, per the article's own heroImageAlt framing.
stroke_weight: 2px (3px on the sparkline polyline itself, matching the family's emphasis convention for the focal trajectory)
alt: A coral sparkline climbing steadily across seven data points, flattening at a ceiling for two of them, then dipping downward at the final point, plotted against a warm-grey keyboard silhouette, with a small warm-bronze theme dot in the upper-right margin.
notes: x coordinates for the eight weekly points (150, 279, 407, 536, 664, 793, 921, 1050) reuse the exact grid from hall-effect-rapid-trigger-plateau.svg, this tracker row's prior hero-art entry, for visual continuity across the series. y coordinates are a stylized plot of the spark array [98, 97, 98, 98, 99, 100, 100, 95] from data/trends/2026-W44.json, not a pixel-literal linear scale, consistent with family convention for sparkline hero art. No rendered text anywhere in the file; the climb, ceiling, and drop carry the subject without labels. All XML comments use single-hyphen text only (no double-hyphen runs) per the svg-validity.test.ts regression guard at apps/web/src/__tests__/svg-validity.test.ts; verified locally with a minidom parse plus a manual double-hyphen scan inside comment bodies, both clean.
